title: Final review of the Phase 3 diff  --blocked-by 0iz 0z0 35h 48q 4ys 54n 55i cwa e08 glb her ix9 udp w1c wdb
description:
Review the full Phase 3 diff. The checklist is what must SURVIVE, not what changed.

Specifics this epic earns, because they are the properties its own tickets were written from:
- The reconciler still contains no herdr code (the seam test must still pass, not merely compile).
- The durable-evidence doctrine holds: collect makes zero substrate calls, proven by the all-errors fixture, not by reading the code.
- A run survives an operator observing it: fetch in the run's checkout, list findings, read the branch — none of it may end the run. This is what ea1baed fixed; re-prove it end to end rather than trusting the guard test.
- Every refusal still tears down exactly what it should and no more.

Verify a claimed defect against the base commit before any repair is built on it. This epic has already cost one repair built on a defect that did not exist.
